items.title: Launching the Vite Ecosystem Fund
items.summary: Cloudflare is distributing the first $301,300 of the Vite Ecosystem Fund to open source projects and maintainers. The recipients were chosen by a panel of Vite stack core team members, including maintainers not employed by Cloudflare.
